en.title: Create and inspect PDFs
en.description: Generate, extract, and visually inspect PDFs with Python and page rendering.
tasks: Generate, extract, and visually inspect PDFs with Python and page rendering.
prerequisites: Python with reportlab, pdfplumber, pypdf; Poppler for rendering.
en.example: Use pdf. Create a two-page summary PDF from these notes and render both pages to check the layout.
en.expectedResult: A PDF plus rendered page previews with layout issues identified.
limitations: Text extraction alone cannot verify layout; scanned documents may need separate OCR.

zh.title: 创建与检查 PDF
zh.description: 使用 Python 和页面渲染创建、提取与检查 PDF。
tasks: 使用 Python 和页面渲染创建、提取与检查 PDF。
prerequisites: Python 与 reportlab、pdfplumber、pypdf；页面渲染需 Poppler。
zh.example: 请使用 pdf：根据这些笔记制作两页摘要 PDF，并渲染两页检查版式。
zh.expectedResult: PDF 文件、页面预览及发现的版式问题。
limitations: 文本提取无法验证版式；扫描文档可能需要额外 OCR。
